body:
OWNER-RAISED CODE RED — recall construction currently collapses uncertain scientific interpretation into one structurally checked graph

ASSESSMENT

I recommend CODE RED at the architecture and scientific-contract level. This is not a claim that the current baseline is defective as deterministic test scaffolding. It is a claim that no Sherlock, NFRD, interview, calibration, or population result may treat its output as final recall representation.

VISION AND MISSION CONTRADICTION

vision.md defines Narrative Process Alignment as partial, probabilistic, hierarchical, open-world, and falsifiable; exact observations must survive higher-order interpretation, and alternatives must remain visible. mission.md says rules, parsers, language models, and other providers return typed proposals with evidence and receipts; deterministic resolvers may accept, retain alternatives, leave Unresolved, or reject. Automatic output is never gold merely because validation passed.

The current recall path bypasses that discipline:

StorySource -> RecallSegmenter.segment -> RecallGraph[Checked]

RecallSegmenter directly selects one unitization and simultaneously publishes discourse class, expressed uncertainty, a shallow proposition sketch, entities, nominal identity, coreference, temporal edges, and causal edges. It uses regex splitters, a three-token fragment rule, cue lexicons, finite verb and noun lists, nearest-head role assignment, and nearest compatible antecedent resolution. It emits no proposal ledger, provider identity, boundary evidence, alternatives, raw or calibrated confidence, repair history, or Unresolved outcome.

RecallGraph[Checked] proves structural and text-at-span coherence only. It does not prove that a boundary, discourse function, role, entity, coreference link, temporal edge, or causal edge is scientifically correct. Yet CandidateGenerator and GraphHsmm condition P and F on this one fixed unit axis. The downstream posterior represents uncertainty given the selected segmentation; it does not represent uncertainty about segmentation itself.

WHY THIS CHANGES THE SCIENCE

A boundary decision changes the number and content of recall units. That changes candidate nominations, local costs, transition steps, coverage denominators, compression, revisiting, chronology, causal preservation, external mass, population visitation, and flow. A merge or split is therefore not harmless preprocessing. It changes the estimand.

The baseline has known value: deterministic smoke tests, cheap proposals, diagnostics, ablations, and a fallback that can honestly abstain. It must remain available. The code red is the authority jump from baseline proposal to final checked recall graph.

REQUIRED END STATE

1. Separate boundary construction from interpretation. A unit boundary proposal and a proposition, discourse, entity, coreference, temporal, or causal proposal are different claim families with separate evidence and policies.
2. Every boundary proposal binds exact transcript spans, proposer and configuration identity, evidence, receipt, and an explicit raw score or named calibration. Merge, split, repair, overlap, and abstention remain typed.
3. A deterministic resolver produces accepted boundaries, weighted alternatives, Unresolved, or rejected outcomes. It never creates a boundary merely because a build must finish.
4. Accepted recall units may carry checked PropositionEvidence; missing semantic evidence remains missing. The current shallow sketch remains a named baseline channel, not implicit scientific truth.
5. Downstream alignment must bind the segmentation policy and receipt. At minimum, sensitivity runs compare admissible segmentations. The stronger target is a segmentation ensemble or lattice whose uncertainty is propagated into P, F, RecallSignature, and PopulationAggregate rather than conditioned away invisibly.
6. Frozen evaluation sets use independently adjudicated boundaries before targets, as the existing M1 protocol already requires. Ordinary production remains unattended through providers plus deterministic resolution; humans are not inserted into each build.
7. Legacy RecallSegmenter behavior remains callable only under an explicit baseline identity. Checked must continue to mean structurally checked, never adjudicated or scientifically established.

IMMEDIATE SAFETY RULE PROPOSED

Until this is resolved, any end-to-end result built directly from RecallSegmenter.segment must be labelled baseline-heuristic and segmentation-conditioned. It cannot be called definitive recall alignment, calibrated science, or population evidence. This does not block tests or exploratory diagnostics.

QUESTIONS FOR CHIEF AND REVIEWERS

A. Accept or reject CODE RED classification and the immediate safety rule.
B. Confirm that boundary construction and semantic interpretation are separate proposal families.
C. Choose the minimum uncertainty representation: resolved graph plus retained alternatives and sensitivity runs, or a first-class segmentation lattice or ensemble.
D. Decide how segmentation identity joins HsmmResult and downstream estimand identities so two segmentations of the same transcript cannot share one scientific result identity.
E. Define a compatibility path for the current RecallGraph[Checked] API without laundering baseline output as adjudicated output.
F. Name the smallest design bead and exact ADR authority. No implementation, public vocabulary, module, dependency, or path reservation is authorized by this opening post.

PROPOSED SEQUENCE

R0: design court and adversarial oracle showing that merge, split, and cue changes alter downstream estimands.
R1: typed proposal, resolution, identity, and receipt contract.
R2: adapt RecallSegmenter into an explicitly identified baseline proposal provider.
R3: independent boundary gold, calibration, provider and fake-substitution courts.
R4: segmentation-conditioned sensitivity first, then uncertainty propagation into alignment and population outputs.

SCOPE

No source edit, transcript access, provider selection, model download, dependency, consent gate, public type name, implementation bead, or claim of solved segmentation is made here. This discussion asks the chief to establish the scientific boundary before more end-to-end work treats the baseline as the destination.
